label: Merchandise/Services Not Received
notes: Strong evidence category if delivery proof exists; weak if merchant relies on estimated delivery windows only.

label: Incorrect Transaction Amount
notes: Usually clerical; high win rate if itemized receipt matches charged amount.

label: Other Fraud - Card-Absent Environment
notes: Hard category. AVS/CVV match alone rarely wins; needs corroborating behavioral evidence.

label: Cardholder Dispute - Defective/Not as Described
notes: Subjective category; outcome heavily depends on communication log tone/content, hard to fully automate confidence.

label: No Cardholder Authorization
notes: Among the hardest to win without 3DS/step-up authentication evidence.

label: Card Not Present - Fraud
notes: Behavioral/device evidence matters more than transaction data alone.

label: Not as Described / Defective Merchandise
notes: Frequently subjective; evidence strength varies a lot case to case.
